spots.name: Medoc Mountain State Park
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Iron Bridge Road
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Fort Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 76 m (249 ft).

spots.name: Panacea Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
